sentences.en: Jack isn't here. He may have missed his usual bus.
sentences.zh: 杰克没来。他可能错过了他的常规公交。

sentences.en: It is imperative that you be on time as usual.
sentences.zh: 你必须像往常一样准时。

sentences.en: As usual, Mike turned up on time. He's very punctual.
sentences.zh: 迈克像往常一样准时到了。他非常守时。

senses.zh: 通常的，常有的，常见的,平常的，普通的,平时的，平日的,一向的，老是那一套的
